summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (41 tests) under the prepared venv. Nothing committed. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-check and lint gates were applied by reading the code only. Judgment call: the arg-type type-ignore sits on the parser call inside the pytest.raises block rather than on the with line. Spec note: the empty list () is rdf:nil, so it hits the rdf:nil branch, not the empty-sequence branch; the one-item case covers the sequence length check.
